text: to make them come in useful, there are lots of ways and means. For instance, when our Jimmy goes out fishing with a pin, what he'll do is stick up on his rod to catch the tiddler's in. Old Mother Lee, she didn't care a thing for none of me. When she won the costume, all she did was shake the tree. Some are blouses, some are blouses, and they tell me that they're great.
